title: Leaf count after pruning a subprotocol path
statement: Let $s$ and $p$ be deterministic two-party communication protocols, and let $s$ lie along a subprotocol path inside $p$, so that $s$ occurs as a rooted subtree of $p$. If $s$ has strictly fewer leaves than $p$, that is, if the number of leaves of $s$ is less than the number of leaves of $p$, then the protocol obtained by pruning this path from $p$ has exactly $\text{numLeaves}(p) - \text{numLeaves}(s)$ leaves.
hypotheses_covered: s and p are deterministic communication protocols
a subprotocol path witnessing s as a rooted subtree of p
the number of leaves of s is strictly less than the number of leaves of p
